subject.title: fix: A2A handoffs can duplicate message-tool replies

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's waited A2A reply boundary, where transcript-only OpenClaw rows, projected message-tool mirrors, and inter-session rows stop reply extraction instead of falling back to older assistant text?
rationale: The change is a plausible narrow fix with proof, but it sits on a core message-delivery boundary where maintainers must accept the suppression tradeoff and current merge conflict resolution.

options.title: Land After Conflict Refresh
options.body: Resolve the dirty merge state, rerun the QA Gateway/channel duplicate-window proof, and merge if no new regression appears.

options.title: Ask For Live Transport Proof
options.body: Require a redacted WhatsApp or comparable live transport run showing one requester-visible reply before accepting the delivery-boundary change.

options.title: Pause For A2A Consolidation
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want one branch to consolidate the message-tool mirror, reverse sessions_send, and compaction replay duplicate roots.

recommendation.title: Land After Conflict Refresh
recommendation.body: Resolve the dirty merge state, rerun the QA Gateway/channel duplicate-window proof, and merge if no new regression appears.
